units.source_text: 父亲脸色阴沉下来。

en.t: Father's face darkened.

units.source_text: 父亲从不曾离开住惯了的农村，根本不知道外面是怎么回事。

en.t: Father had never left the village where he had always lived, and he had no idea what things were like outside.

units.source_text: 经常有乡下人问他，孩子大学毕业后拿多少薪水，

en.t: People from the countryside often asked him how much salary a child would earn after graduating from university,

units.source_text: 或者问，能挣一百多块吧？

en.t: or asked whether it would be more than a hundred yuan.

units.source_text: 所以，父亲为了名声好些，总是希望刚刚毕业的我赶紧有个着落。

en.t: So, for the sake of appearances, Father always wanted me, newly graduated, to settle into some position as soon as possible.

units.source_text: 在父母的眼里，一向把大城市当作立身之地的我，

en.t: In my parents' eyes, I, who had always taken the big city as the place where I would make my life,

units.source_text: 无异于想要天马行空的异形人。

en.t: was no different from some strange person who wanted to roam through the sky.

units.source_text: 其实我也常常觉得自己是这种怪人，

en.t: In truth, I too often felt that I was this kind of odd person,

units.source_text: 尽管我很想说明自己的想法，

en.t: although I very much wanted to explain my own thoughts,

units.source_text: 但在思想差距过于悬殊的父母面前只好保持沉默。

en.t: but before parents whose way of thinking was far too different from mine, I could only remain silent.

units.source_text: “你可以去求求你常念叨的那位先生啊，现在正是时候。”

en.t: "You could go and ask that先生 you are always talking about; now is exactly the time."

units.source_text: 母亲除此之外，并不了解先生。

en.t: Beyond this, Mother did not understand Sensei at all.

units.source_text: 那位先生正是劝我回家后，趁父亲还活着的时候，赶快分财产的人，

en.t: That Sensei was precisely the person who had urged me, after I returned home, to divide the property quickly while Father was still alive,

units.source_text: 而不是我毕业后，可以帮忙介绍工作的人。

en.t: not someone who could help introduce me to a job after my graduation.

units.source_text: “那位先生是干什么的？”

en.t: "What does that Sensei do?"

units.source_text: 父亲问。

en.t: Father asked.

units.source_text: “什么也不干。”

en.t: "He does not do anything."

units.source_text: 我答道。

en.t: I answered.

units.source_text: 我觉得老早以前就告诉过他们先生没有出来做事，

en.t: I felt that I had told them long ago that Sensei did not go out to work,

units.source_text: 父亲也应该记得的。

en.t: and Father ought to have remembered it.

units.source_text: “什么都没干，又是因为什么呢？

en.t: "If he does nothing at all, what is the reason for that?

units.source_text: 既然是你那么尊敬的人，总该做点事吧。”

en.t: Since he is someone you respect so much, surely he ought to be doing something."

units.source_text: 父亲故意这样讥讽我。

en.t: Father deliberately mocked me in this way.

units.source_text: 在父亲的脑子里，凡是有能耐的人，大都应该在社会上有相当的地位。

en.t: In Father's mind, anyone with real ability ought, for the most part, to have a proper position in society.

units.source_text: 于是，父亲得出了结论，先生准是个无能之辈，所以才游手好闲的。

en.t: So Father had concluded that Sensei must be a useless sort of man, and that was why he idled his days away.
